title: TestRun
description: An execution instance of acceptance criteria tests across one or more stories or scenarios

id.description: Unique identifier for the test run

storyIds.description: User story IDs included in this test run

scenarioIds.description: Specific scenario IDs included in this test run

totalScenarios.description: Total number of scenarios in this run

skippedScenarios.description: Number of scenarios that were skipped

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the test run started

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the test run completed

reportUrl.description: URL to the detailed test run report
